pairs: Et post dies sex assumit Jesus Petrum, et Jacobum,
And after six days, Jesus took Peter and James and his brother John,
et Joannem fratrem ejus, et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum:
and he led them onto a lofty mountain separately.
And he was transfigured before them.
Et resplenduit facies ejus sicut sol:
And his face shined brightly like the sun.
vestimenta autem ejus facta sunt alba sicut nix.
And his garments were made white like snow.
Et ecce apparuerunt illis Moyses et Elias cum eo loquentes.
And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah, speaking with him.
Respondens autem Petrus, dixit ad Jesum:
And Peter responded by saying to Jesus: “Lord,
Domine, bonum est nos hic esse:
it is good for us to be here. If you are willing,
let us make three tabernacles here,
And while he was still speaking,
behold, a shining cloud overshadowed them.
Et ecce vox de nube, dicens:
And behold, there was a voice from the cloud,
with whom I am well pleased.
Et audientes discipuli ceciderunt in faciem suam,
And the disciples, hearing this, fell prone on their face,
And as they were descending from the mountain,
donec Filius hominis a mortuis resurgat.
until the Son of man has risen from the dead.”
And his disciples questioned him, saying,
dicentes: Quid ergo scribæ dicunt, quod Eliam oporteat primum venire?
“Why then do the scribes say that it is necessary for Elijah to arrive first?”
But in response, he said to them:
Elias quidem venturus est, et restituet omnia.
indeed, shall arrive and restore all things.
and they did not recognize him,
sed fecerunt in eo quæcumque voluerunt.
but they did whatever they wanted to him.
Sic et Filius hominis passurus est ab eis.
So also shall the Son of man suffer from them.”
Tunc intellexerunt discipuli, quia de Joanne Baptista dixisset eis.
Then the disciples understood that he had spoken to them about John the Baptist.
And when he had arrived at the multitude,
accessit ad eum homo genibus provolutus ante eum,
a man approached him, falling to his knees before him,
For he frequently falls into fire,
And I brought him to your disciples,
but they were not able to cure him.”
How long shall I be with you?
How long shall I endure you?
and the demon went out of him,
et curatus est puer ex illa hora.
and the boy was cured from that hour.
Tunc accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum secreto,
Then the disciples approached Jesus privately
Quare nos non potuimus ejicere illum?
“Why were we unable to cast him out?”
Amen I say to you, certainly,
si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis,
if you will have faith like a grain of mustard seed,
you will say to this mountain,
And nothing will be impossible for you.
Hoc autem genus non ejicitur nisi per orationem
But this kind is not cast out,
And when they were conversing together in Galilee,
Filius hominis tradendus est in manus hominum:
“The Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
but he will rise again on the third day.”
And when they had arrived at Capernaum,
accesserunt qui didrachma accipiebant ad Petrum,
those who collected the half shekel approached Peter,
“Doesn’t your Teacher pay the half shekel?”
And when he had entered into the house,
reges terræ a quibus accipiunt tributum
from whom do they receive tribute or the census tax:
from their own sons or from foreigners?”
But so that we may not become an obstacle to them:
and take the first fish that is brought up,
and when you have opened its mouth,
da eis pro me et te.
